messages:
emma_csm: Quick flag from this morning's weekly health run: hosted usage vs commit spike for three customers between 08:50-09:20 UTC. automated anomaly score > 0.9.

rick_ops: Do we have dollar exposure numbers? want to know if renewal risk or just transient overshoot.

leah_data: Pulled the runbook query. summary: cust-omega projected $12.4k this month if current rate continues, commit is $4k. spike duration ~18m with peak tpm ~4x baseline. attaching short query: 
```sql
-- short window spike detection
SELECT org, sum(tokens) AS tokens, avg(tokens_per_min) AS tpm
FROM hosted_usage
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-18T08:45:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-18T09:30:00Z'
GROUP BY org
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

emma_csm: Thanks. Which of these are on managed commits vs invoice-only?

jules_fin: cust-omega and cust-sierra are on monthly commits. cust-sierra commit = $8k, projected spend $9.2k (low overage). cust-omega is the concerning one (3x). I'll mark cust-omega as "high variance" in the ledger for the moment.

healthbot: alert: short-window-spend-anomaly detected for orgs: cust-omega, cust-sierra, cust-lumen. anomaly_score: 0.92. linked_runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/spend-spike

rick_ops: Any correlated infra events? we had an early-morning kernel upgrade in eu-west at 08:40 but that shouldn't affect us-west customers. checking traces...

leah_data: Traces show higher request fanout and a 5% surge in session starts for cust-omega during the window. error rate stayed flat, no 5xx burst. looks client-driven.

emma_csm: Good to know. I'll loop in CSM ownership. Suggest we prep a calm outreach: explain spike, offer 1x month credit if they hit commit again next month, and ask if they changed client config.

jules_fin: Agreed. Finance prefers case-by-case but supportive of small credits for churn prevention. Proposed credit cap $2k for cust-omega.

billingbot: billing: provisional charge estimate for cust-omega if spike persists = $12,400. awaiting finalization.

emma_csm: Action items: 1) leah to export affected request_ids + session_ids and flag retried vs unique (ETA 2h). 2) rick to check if any rollout or routing change could surface increased session starts (ETA 1h). 3) jules to draft customer note and credit proposal (ETA EOD). 4) healthbot to add a new detector to the weekly pack that surfaces 5-20min high-variance windows vs commit baseline.

leah_data: Starting the export now. will DM list to emma and rick once ready. :mag:

rick_ops: I'll grep deploy logs and routing diffs in the window. if nothing suspicious, we mark as client-side spike and prioritize outreach.

emma_csm: Thanks all. please drop updates here so we have a single thread for the reconciliation + outreach. :handshake:
